prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets", "Log into your existing account to instantly sync and restore all previously adopted pets and custom settings.", "Using the same sign-in provider guarantees your pet data stays connected."]
1: ["Select Companion"]
2: ["Instant Starter Pet", "Custom Created Pet"]
3: ["Test Idle Animations"]
4: ["Initializing desktop display overlay..."]
5: ["Welcome Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Use tray shortcuts and right-click gestures to manage companion behavior anytime.", "Right-click pet for interaction menu; Drag to relocate; Double-click to sleep"]
6: ["Give Your Pet a Name", "Enter a name to print on your companion's official adoption record.", "Pet Name"]
7: ["Secure & Private Companion Account", "Your data is strictly encrypted. You maintain full ownership and can request complete account and data deletion at any time in settings.", "We never sell personal data or share your custom uploads."]
8: ["Meet your virtual companion living right on your desktop window system."]
9: ["Desktop Pet Controls Cheat-Sheet", "Quick reference for managing desktop placement, visibility, and tray controls.", "Click & Drag to move pet; Tray icon for preferences; Hide pet during fullscreen apps"]
